#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

bool isNumber(const std::string& s) {
    if (s.empty()) return false;
    char* end;
    std::strtoll(s.c_str(), &end, 10);
    return end == s.c_str() + s.length();
}

long long solve(long long n, long long m) {
    long long a = std::min(n, m);
    long long b = std::max(n, m);
    if (a == 1) {
        long long base = b / 6 * 6;
        long long r = b % 6;
        if (r == 4) base += 2;
        if (r == 5) base += 4;
        return base;
    }
    if (a == 2 && b == 2) return 0;
    if (a == 2 && b == 3) return 4;
    if (a == 2 && b == 7) return 12;
    long long res = a * b;
    if (a % 2 == 1 && b % 2 == 1) res--;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    std::vector<long long> nums;
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        std::istringstream iss(line);
        std::string token;
        while (iss >> token) {
            if (isNumber(token)) {
                nums.push_back(std::strtoll(token.c_str(), nullptr, 10));
            }
        }
    }
    long long n = nums.size() > 0 ? nums[0] : 0;
    long long m = nums.size() > 1 ? nums[1] : 0;
    std::cout << solve(n, m) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
